content.summary: Three lighthouse volunteers become wind forms after a shared pier walk. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: Three adult identities and positions are established. + The group walks on one continuous axis. + Release effects begin only near the foreground threshold. + Each person maps to one departing light form. + The original environment remains after departure as proof.
quick_start.recommended_input: Place three original adult lighthouse volunteers shoulder to shoulder on one dawn harbor pier with folded translucent sail-cloaks. Let the trio walk together toward camera along the same center seam without changing order. The three wind shapes lift beyond frame in order, leaving the same empty pier and three folded name tags as quiet proof.
